args.body: Finish existing PARSER-PARITY-SITE-REVIEW after reconciling its actual lease. Inspect the immediately preceding execution and dry-run receipts; read the saved independent execution artifact and count actual assertions, not merely exit codes. A command or invocation failure is not automatically a product defect: inspect the documented invocation before drawing conclusions. Reuse valid completed source inspection. Finish RFC section 5.6 versus Appendix A, leap-second policy, payload equality, EN/FR disclosure, hypothetical CAD150 offer, plain-text intake and static CSP checks. Save/read consolidated evidence, record supported APPROVE or concrete NEEDS_WORK for exact digest 465e390a16e262ba46ba88deaf1bce8bd172a4ee0418962bccfb09861cc74c13, and close with a valid lease and lesson. Do not edit or deploy. If approved, hand full per-file hashes to ACQUISITION for a later eligible host-gated release with fetched-byte verification. Stop after this finite review. Preserve existing tender expiry duties. Synthetic evidence establishes neither customers nor revenue; unclassified feedback remains unknown demand.
